name: Mia
source:
Mia, Ashley's Mother and the owner of the local cafe is a mysterious character who's exact intentions are not always clear. Being recently divorced, she and Nicole share a bond that goes deeper then one may expect. With a wealth of sexual experience, she is able share some of her knowledge with anyone she desires.

[In game description]
